topic: Sudden double vision: why it's urgent

youtube.title: Suddenly seeing double? Don't ignore it ⚠️👀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Suddenly seeing two of everything? Don't brush it off.
திடீரென எல்லாம் இரண்டாகத் தெரிகிறதா? அலட்சியம் வேண்டாம்!

• Six tiny muscles move each eye, controlled by nerves from the brain.
• If the eyes stop lining up, the brain gets two pictures and you see double.
• Quick check: cover one eye. If the double image goes away, the eyes are misaligned.
• Sudden double vision can be linked to diabetes, high blood pressure, stroke or nerve problems.
• Go to a hospital immediately if it comes with severe headache, drooping eyelid, weakness, slurred speech or dizziness.
• Don't drive. Get checked the same day.

gmb.text: Sudden double vision should never be ignored. Six small muscles move each eye, controlled by nerves from the brain. If the eyes stop lining up, the brain receives two different pictures and you see double. A simple check is to cover one eye: if the double image disappears, the eyes are not aligned and a doctor needs to find out why. Sudden double vision can be linked to diabetes, high blood pressure, stroke or nerve problems. Go to a hospital immediately if it comes with a severe headache, a drooping eyelid, weakness, slurred speech or dizziness, and do not drive. This is general information, not a diagnosis.
